name: Lim Wei Loong
bio:
Lim Wei Loong's journey into motorsport security began with a background in the Singapore Police Force, where he honed his skills in risk assessment and crisis management. After a decade of service, a chance encounter with a racing team owner at a local car show led to a career pivot. He quickly adapted his law enforcement expertise to the unique demands of the motorsport world, focusing on track safety, pit lane security, and crowd control.

Lim's approach is methodical and proactive. He believes in identifying potential vulnerabilities before they become problems, emphasizing thorough planning and constant vigilance. His experience has taught him the importance of clear communication and collaboration with all team members, from drivers to mechanics, to ensure a safe and secure environment for everyone involved. What sets him apart is his ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure, a trait invaluable in the high-stakes world of motorsport.

physical.description: Lim is of medium build, with a serious demeanor and a watchful gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook and pen.
Insists on conducting a full security briefing before any major event, even if it seems repetitive.
Has a habit of double-checking every lock and seal, no matter how secure it appears.
